name: The Homestead Shopping Center
summary: The Homestead Shopping Center is a community-focused retail destination in northwest Austin featuring anchor tenants Barnes & Noble and Petco, along with a diverse mix of specialty shops, restaurants, and service providers. Conveniently located near Lakeline Mall on Highway 183, this center offers a one-stop shopping experience for families seeking everyday retail, dining, and professional services.
demographics: The Homestead Shopping Center serves the northwest Austin suburban market, primarily attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from nearby residential communities including Cedar Park and Leander. The trade area consists of young families with children, dual-income households, and growing suburban populations seeking convenient access to everyday shopping, dining, and services. Visitors typically engage in multi-purpose shopping trips, combining errands at anchor stores like Barnes & Noble and Petco with dining experiences and specialty retail visits.
description: The Homestead Shopping Center is a premier shopping destination located in northwest Austin, Texas, strategically positioned at the intersection of Highway 183 and Lakeline Mall Boulevard, just moments from Lakeline Mall. This well-established community center has become a neighborhood favorite by offering a carefully curated mix of national retailers, local businesses, and dining options that cater to the everyday needs of Austin families. Anchored by Barnes & Noble and Petco, The Homestead features an impressive lineup of specialty retailers including Kid to Kid, Wild Birds Unlimited, and Salons by JC, providing everything from children's resale items to birding supplies and professional beauty services. The center's tagline, "Find what you need and feel at home," perfectly captures its welcoming atmosphere and comprehensive tenant mix that serves shoppers whether they're redecorating their homes, running Sunday errands, or enjoying a meal out. With its convenient location, ample parking, and diverse selection of shopping, dining, and service options, The Homestead has established itself as an essential part of the northwest Austin retail landscape.
